name: Brudiclad, Telchor Engineer — each other token you control becomes a copy of the chosen token
notes: Sweep group 5, mass copies (2026-10-07). "If you do, each other token you control becomes a copy of that token." was pinned to Brudiclad itself. A mass copy is one layer 1 copy effect over the whole group; what is copied is picked with the copy picker and is never one of the copies. Thopter token chosen: the Shard and Servo tokens are Thopters; Grizzly Bears and Brudiclad are not tokens.
